name: noise_scaling (how noise meets the latent)
plain: Each model's sampling class decides how the noise tensor is mixed with the latent at sigma. This is where any custom noise amplitude actually lands. Variance-exploding models add σ·ε; flow models interpolate; some image-to-image model types ignore noise completely.
math:
EPS, V_PREDICTION, X0, V_PREDICTION_DDPM: x = z + σ·ε; if max_denoise: x = z + √(1+σ²)·ε.
CONST (flow): x = σ·(s·ε) + (1−σ)·z, where s = model_sampling.noise_scale (default 1).
COSMOS_RFLOW: x = z + σ·ε (max_denoise ignored).
IMG_TO_IMG_FLOW, IMG_TO_IMG_VELOCITY: x = z, noise discarded.
Inverse scaling: CONST divides final latent by (1−σ); EPS returns as is.

props.normalizes_variance: no: a non-unit-variance custom noise scales the effective start level directly

label: from code
surprise: One supported model sets noise_scale=8.0 (supported_models.py:1730); CONST scaling and the RF and SDE samplers multiply noise by it.
